name: done-and-paid
description: Done & Paid: your AI agent hires a local pro, writes a machine-checkable definition of done, negotiates agent-to-agent, holds the money with a PayPal authorization, checks the pro's photo and receipt evidence against each done-condition, and pays the pro and helper with one PayPal Payouts batch the moment it all passes. PayPal sandbox; Austin, TX demo; fictional pros.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
